summary: Steep cul-de-sac kerb with houses 9-23 m away and no room.
reasons: Houses 9-10 m from kerb along most of it
Narrow bend with no parking convention

best_section.where: North kerb at the lower end of Hoylake Street, past the pool-side house before the bend

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings sit 9 m (at 26 m) and 10 m (at 54 m) from the kerb, more on both sides within 25 m; dense gardens and trees but homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street on a hillside curve with no verge or pull-off; a van would sit in the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential cul-de-sac end; only residents.
drivers.convention: No signs and one car seen; no overnight parking habit.

flags: Steep: about 8% at the best section, 22% max over the stretch
Dwellings within 10 m of much of the stretch
Narrow bend with no verge to pull off
Mapped gates and bollard 157-190 m away have a way round
sun_shade: Heavy tree cover on both sides shades the section; some afternoon sun through gaps from the west.
